scope: Authenticated per-origin previews, guest loopback tunnels, owner-bound exact TCP grants

checks.local_tests: pass: daemon, forge, proto, store, engine, netd (KVM disabled)
checks.linux_tests: pass: daemon, forge, proto, store, engine, netd (KVM disabled)

checks: private allow and peer deny with positive host listener
restore-as-new receives no preview or private grant
browser token/cookie scope and cross-origin refusal

limits: Fresh image with current Rust forge is required for previews
No production deployment or host firewall/resolver changes
HTTP/1 previews; no arbitrary CONNECT or anonymous sharing
Five-minute connection lifetime, thirty-second guest idle timeout
Private policy reload requires stopping affected sandboxes
Upload optimization deferred until after Phase 5
